reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and 'Every batch lab-tested', which is a nice touch, but the listing has zero reviews and I don't buy a supplement without hundreds of them. I already have a magnesium that works for me, and I've tried three brands this year.
objection: No reviews at all, so I can't check the 1-star complaints about stomach upset, capsule size or under-dosing. A lab report on a QR code is a claim from the brand, not proof from other buyers.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred verified reviews with a decent share of 4-5 stars and no pattern of stomach or dosing complaints in the 1-star ones, or a cheap trial pack so I can test it without committing $30.
